angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) vs NFL pressure rate beyond a small no-tracking baseline (log pick + weight + 10-yd split + EDGE share), with a selection-honest rescreen of all 7 drill metrics; drill burst kept as a measurement caveat
metric_name: Hoop G: the hardest sideways push a rusher sustains for 0.5 s while rounding the hoops, in g (z within Combine year), shrunk by one-run reliability 0.41 for the board
headline_number: Hoop G vs pressure after baseline: rho 0.34 [0.09, 0.56], n=63; out-of-class dR2 +0.075 [-0.253, 0.335] (refit bootstrap). Selection: best-of-7 permutation p=0.058; nested LOCO re-selects Hoop G in 3/3 folds, dR2 +0.080, p=0.025; EB-shrunk effect 0.12 (~1.0 pressure/450 rushes vs 2.9 unshrunk). Complete-case (10-yd missing dropped) 0.22 [-0.10, 0.49], n=49, dR2 +0.003.
what_changed_from_previous: Smaller 4-covariate baseline plus robustness table (6-cov OLS, ridge, complete-case without imputation, class random-intercept mixed model, snap cuts); full rescreen of 7 drill metrics with max-over-metrics permutation and a nested leave-one-class-out selection test; EB selection-shrunk effect; refit bootstrap for out-of-class dR2; Hoop G reliability with bootstrap CI (split-half SB 0.41 [0.14, 0.60], 10 repeaters ICC 0.37 [-0.11, 0.73]) and MDE over that range; burst EDGE-interior contrast given a CI and labelled descriptive; top-EPA replication (fails, 0.11). New 70-word opening, coach definition of Hoop G and football mechanism with stance/alignment/scheme caveats; 'Bend reappears' softened to 'a lead'; 'What a team can use' moved up with shrinkage arithmetic for Downs, Ezeiruaku and Phillips; single pre-registered 2026-27 hypothesis with power (0.65 at observed, 0.17 at shrunk). Figures cut from 5+1 table to 4+2 tables: drill-vs-game cards with snap-aligned NFL tracks and pressure strip, neutral title; signal map sorted by effect with reliability strip and NGS inset, labelled grey band; Hoop G panel with de-overlapped labels, per-class dot plot with bootstrap intervals and best-of-7 null histogram; full 2025 board of 42 hoop runners with intervals, weight, role, rookie-vs-drill flags and binomial count. Stats moved to an appendix table; 1,717 words.
open_risks: Best-of-7 permutation p=0.058 does not clear 0.05; only the nested test does (p=0.025) and the EB-shrunk effect is small (0.12).
Complete-case analysis without imputed 10-yd splits weakens the lead to 0.22 with zero out-of-class gain; the 6-covariate complete case (n=22) is uninformative.
Out-of-class dR2 CI includes zero; the 2025 rookie check moves only 11 of 20 forecasts closer (binomial p=0.41).
Hoop reliability is uncertain (0.14-0.60), so the true-scale detectable effect ranges 0.52-1.00; pre-registered test has power 0.17 if the shrunk effect is true.
Board 'disagreement' flag uses NFL rookie pressure vs a no-tracking forecast as a stand-in for film; no scheme, alignment-technique or injury data.
